name: PT Bakrieland Development Tbk
summary: PT Bakrieland Development Tbk operates as an integrated property company in Indonesia. The company develops and sells urban properties, landed residential estates, office buildings, malls, commercial areas, hotels, and resorts, as well as theme parks and food courts.
